title: Reconcile a task worktree after an approved base change
requirements: Add a controller command that rebases a clean task worktree onto its unchanged integration branch and refreshes the task base, invalidating previous validation and review seals.
Require an active or review-state task, a clean integration checkout, and no tracked or staged changes in the task worktree before reconciliation; failed rebase must surface as a pipeline error.
Add a regression test covering a task with a committed change, an advanced integration branch, reconciliation, and successful new validation. Document when to use the command.
acceptance: An approved unrelated merge no longer makes an in-flight task impossible to finish after successful rebase and revalidation.
Old review and validation records cannot be reused after reconciliation.

shared_paths_approval.reason: PIPE-006 legitimately advanced master while ENV-001 was in review, revealing that the documented reconcile path is missing from the controller.
